exposure: external cephalic version (ECV) with tocolysis and sedation or spinal anesthesia
cohort: The study included 990 pregnant women with term non-cephalic presentation at a tertiary hospital in Spain.
finding: ECV performed with systematic tocolysis and sedation or spinal anesthesia achieved high success (69.8%) and low complication rates (10.2%), particularly when associated with a deeper amniotic fluid pocket or transverse lie, while nulliparity and higher BMI were associated with lower success.
mod_finding: After successful ECV, 80.5% (556/691) of women delivered vaginally.
